tagline: Enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer
hero_kpi_rationale: The Services and Consumables segment represents 83% of revenue, illustrating Thermo Fisher's recurring and resilient business model, a key driver of its growth and profitability in the life sciences sector.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total sales generated by the company during the year.
kpis.description: Revenue reached $42.88 billion in 2024, supported by strong demand in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors.
kpis.signal: Strong revenue growth driven by high demand in pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors

kpis.name: Adjusted EPS
kpis.explanation: Earnings per share adjusted for non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Adjusted EPS reached $21.86 in 2024, reflecting strong profitability despite sector-wide pressures.
kpis.signal: Strong adjusted EPS demonstrates solid financial performance and operational efficiency

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated after investments, available for dividends, share buybacks, or debt repayment.
kpis.description: Free cash flow amounted to $7.3 billion in 2024, supporting share buybacks and strategic acquisitions.
kpis.signal: Robust free cash flow generation enabling shareholder returns and strategic investments

kpis.name: R&D
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in research and development.
kpis.description: $1.4 billion invested in R&D in 2024 to launch new technologies in spectrometry and cellular therapies.
kpis.signal: Significant R&D investment supporting innovation in spectrometry and cellular therapies

kpis.name: Services & Consumables Revenue
kpis.explanation: Portion of sales related to recurring products such as reagents and services.
kpis.description: 83% of revenue comes from services and consumables, ensuring high visibility and resilience.
kpis.signal: Dominant recurring revenue model providing visibility and resilience to financial performance

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.description: The company employs 125,000 people, supporting its commercial engine and global operations.
kpis.signal: Large global workforce supporting operational scale and worldwide customer relationships

kpis.name: Olink Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Strategic acquisition of Olink to strengthen proteomics offering.
kpis.description: The acquisition of Olink in 2024 for $3.1 billion strengthens leadership in proteomics and opens new opportunities in precision medicine.
kpis.signal: Strategic investment in proteomics driving next-generation life sciences capabilities

risks.title: Dependence on sole suppliers
risks.score_rationale: The risk is highlighted centrally in Item 1A, with strong language ("could cause production interruptions"). The trend is stable, but the category is critical for supply chain. Sector weight is high due to strict quality regulations.

risks.title: Information systems cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: High prominence in the document, with very intense language ("could materially harm our operating results"). The risk is increasing due to growing digitalization. The category is strategic, with high weight due to sensitivity of medical and commercial data.

risks.title: Successful integration of acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: Frequently and thoroughly mentioned in risks, with concerned language ("may not realize anticipated cost savings"). Trend is stable, but the category is strategic. Weight is high due to the acquisition-led growth model.

risks.title: Competition with large customers and suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Significant position in the text, with clear language on commercial impact. Trend is stable. The category is central to market dynamics. Weight is high due to the size of strategic customers.

risks.title: Dependence on public spending trends
risks.score_rationale: Moderate positioning, measured but recurring language. Trend is stable. The category is macroeconomic but business-specific. Weight is medium as a significant portion of customers are public or grant-funded entities.

risks.title: Anticipating needs of innovative customers
risks.score_rationale: Key position within technology risks, strong language on innovation. Trend is stable. The category is central to R&D. Weight is high due to the importance of technological disruption in the sector.

risks.title: International regulation and data compliance
risks.score_rationale: High positioning, cautious language on varying requirements. Trend is stable. The category is critical for global expansion. Weight is high due to market diversity and sensitive data processing.

ai_positioning.summary: Thermo Fisher is gradually integrating artificial intelligence into its analytical platforms, particularly for proteomic data interpretation and biomarker discovery. The acquisition of Olink and its role in the UK Biobank demonstrate a commitment to advanced data analytics, although AI is not yet a central pillar of communication.
evidence: Use of large-scale data analytics through the UK Biobank project
Olink platform applied to biomarker discovery with complex data processing
Launch of instruments integrating advanced digital workflows
